title: Threat, Force, category, context and hint SCP predicates
scope: Eight bounded original PC script predicates, named/numeric initializers and native helper composition. No whole-game source or runtime reconstruction.

conditions.name: OpponentIsAThreat
conditions.scope: Null script creature returns0; otherwise returns flags at creature+0x1e8 bit0x800 as float0/1. Does not compute opponent threat.

conditions.name: ForceBeingUsed
conditions.scope: Named registry initializer returns target first pointer. Predicate returns0 on null target; otherwise1 if target+0xa0 bit0x200000 or target+0x3c pointer nonzero. User-link presence is not a resolved actor or player-use test.

conditions.name: ForceFinished
conditions.scope: Null target returns0. Calls original helper0x467860: bound target with null group+0x28 returns1; with group present, state+0xc must equal0 when target flags+0xa0 bit0x40, else2. This omits ForceComplete flags/timer gates. Direct helper0x467860 returns1 for a null target; the SCP wrapper adds its own null=>0 gate.

conditions.name: PlayerCategoryIs
conditions.scope: Initializer requires system, operand and category table; first case-insensitive category name sets index or-1. Predicate uses primary player global0x93d810 only, rejects-1 or absent player, then calls original0x55bc80 capability masks. Definition-mask bit8 excludes actor class flag0x8000. Full prepared definition/class backing is required for fields read.

conditions.name: InContext
conditions.scope: Context name initializer recognizes eleven names; unmatched/null operands select100. Predicate guards null creature,self reference and referenced object, then compares sign-extended object context byte+0x7b5 to full initialized int.

conditions.name: OpponentContext
conditions.scope: Same initializer as InContext. Predicate guards null creature and opponent reference+0xe4; it omits referenced object null guard. Nonnull reference/null object faults native; portable source throws. Context comparison sign-extends byte+0x7b5 before comparing full int.

conditions.name: HintAvailable
conditions.scope: Decimal-prefix int32-wrapping initializer, null=>0. Wrapper rejects initialized0. Helper rejects active or negative ID or unregistered hint, scans signed-short sentinel list for first ID, requires completion byte0 and timer<=0 OR quiet-NaN unordered comparison. Hint updates and registration population are external.

offsets.registrationTable: 0x926c20 holds backing pointer; dword read at [backing+id*4]

conditions.name: HintComplete
conditions.scope: Same numeric initializer as HintAvailable; wrapper rejects initialized0 then converts original helper0x576500 completion byte presence to float0/1. Helper scans signed-short sentinel list, first matching ID, returns full uint8+0x14. Helper ID0 behavior is not wrapper behavior.

assemblyCorrections.detail: fldz; fcomp [eax+0x18]; fnstsw ax; test ah,5; jnp false at0x5764f2. Quiet NaN sets C0/C2 so parity remains even and falls through available1. This differs from ordinary C#/pseudocode timer<=0; source explicitly accepts Single.IsNaN(timer).
movzx eax,byte ptr[ecx+0x14] recovers full unsigned completion byte. Ghidra short-list notation/char return must not truncate or sign-extend.
OpponentContext sign-extends byte after dereferencing reference first pointer without an object-null test; saved original emulation fault documents the missing guard.

verification.managedCompilation: Core and saved-fixture harness independently compiled successfully.
verification.managedExecution: Pending; no launch attempt because environment EPERM restriction is already established.

adapters.scope: Force registry name callback returns prepared fixture record +4 name pointer; generic registry lookup and target-first-pointer extraction remain original.

limits: No game or whole-level execution, source reachability, state producers or lifetime recovery.
Hint registration is unchecked native indexed access; fixtures prepare sufficient synthetic backing without inferring real allocation size.
Hint timer tests include finite float32, infinities and quiet NaN; signaling NaN/x87 exception or payload behavior excluded.
Prepared hint lists require a -1 sentinel; malformed unterminated memory is outside scope.
OpponentContext nonnull reference/null target faults native; portable source throws explicitly rather than manufacturing false.
Compiled C# behavioral run pending under known executable-launch restriction.
preparedMemoryLimits: Force initializer portable callback owns prior recovered generic registry lookup and first-pointer extraction. Only named binding orchestration and returned target identity are claimed here.
Primary player prepared definition/class records, category rows, and list backing are required when corresponding native paths read them.

Global0x926c20 stores registration backing pointer; native dword indexing at [backing+id*4] has no upper bounds gate; portable host read callback must supply the selected nonnegative ID. Fixtures do not infer true registration table size.
Hint list IDs are signed int16 compared against full int32 selector; positive65535 does not alias-1 or any record.
Source condition comparisons validate scalar predicates even when preserved authored line continues on another line; no loader/control reachability claim.
